lines.zh: 秋叶铺满小道，我一步一响。
lines.en: Leaves carpet the trail; every step of mine crackles.

lines.zh: 风穿过我肋骨，我早没知觉。
lines.en: Wind whistles through my ribs. I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 林子红了一半，我也该动了。
lines.en: Half the woods turned red; time to move.

lines.zh: 落叶里没人等我。
lines.en: Nobody waits for me in the leaves.

lines.zh: 森林的颜色，我也染上了。
lines.en: I took on the forest's colors.

lines.zh: 落叶粘在我身上，黄透了。
lines.en: Leaves cling to me, all yellowed.

lines.zh: 秋天的风推着我快走。
lines.en: The autumn wind pushes me along.

lines.zh: 落叶咔咔响，是我的膝盖。
lines.en: That crunch of leaves is my knees.

lines.zh: 我踩碎枯叶，一路咔哒响。
lines.en: I crush dead leaves — click, click, all the way.

lines.zh: 这条林间道，我生前常走。
lines.en: This forest trail was mine when I still breathed.

lines.zh: 我的皮，像枯叶一样卷。
lines.en: My skin curls like dead leaves.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，铁锭就在响。
lines.en: Every step jingles the iron ingot in me.

lines.zh: 我这副秋色的皮，晒不暖。
lines.en: This autumn-colored skin won't warm in the sun.

lines.zh: 眼眶里塞满了枯叶。
lines.en: Dead leaves fill my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤像枯叶一样黄。
lines.en: My skin is yellow as dead leaves.

lines.zh: 安静，安静得过头了。
lines.en: Quiet, far too quiet.

lines.zh: 这棵红树下，我站了很久。
lines.en: I've stood under this red tree a long while.

lines.zh: 脊椎歪了，我还是站着。
lines.en: My spine is crooked, yet I still stand.

lines.zh: 我站在树下，叶子落了满肩。
lines.en: I stand under the tree, leaves on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 花瓣还握在手里。
lines.en: Still holding my petals.

lines.zh: 我的口袋里还有一块铁锭。
lines.en: There's still an iron ingot in my pocket.

lines.zh: 铁锭沉在口袋里。
lines.en: An iron ingot weighs down my pocket.

lines.zh: 活人的热气，飘进我鼻腔。
lines.en: Living warmth drifts into my hollow nose.

lines.zh: 林子里的人，身上还是热的。
lines.en: The one in the woods is still warm.

lines.zh: 他们叫我Auburn Zombie，记住。
lines.en: They call me Auburn Zombie. Remember.

lines.zh: 这片落叶林，缺一个同伴。
lines.en: This leaf-strewn wood could use a companion.

lines.zh: 灯笼光里，你的脸很白。
lines.en: In lantern light your face looks pale.

lines.zh: 别盯着我的脸，它烂了一半。
lines.en: Don't stare at my face. Half of it rotted away.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只是看看你的装备。
lines.en: Don't fear, I am only eyeing your gear.

lines.zh: 你认识我吗？活人。
lines.en: Do you know me? Living one.

lines.zh: 别跑。跑也没用。
lines.en: Don't run. It won't help.

lines.zh: 我在闻你，不是要吃你。
lines.en: I'm sniffing you, not eating you.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨要散了，你赔不起。
lines.en: My ribs are coming apart. You can't pay for that.

lines.zh: 腐肉掉了一地，别打烂我。
lines.en: Rotten flesh is dropping out. Don't smash me.

lines.zh: 我的身体早凉了，不怕这点。
lines.en: My body went cold long ago; this is nothing.

lines.zh: 你还挺有力气，铁剑不错。
lines.en: You are strong, and that iron sword is fine.

lines.zh: 我的手臂脱节了，照样追。
lines.en: My arm came loose. I still chase.

lines.zh: 伤口里塞着枯叶，别翻了。
lines.en: Dead leaves fill that wound. Don't dig in it.

lines.zh: 秋天的皮，一碰就掉色。
lines.en: Autumn skin flakes at a touch.

lines.zh: 活着的时候更疼。
lines.en: It hurt worse alive.

lines.zh: 我还没散架，还能咬。
lines.en: I haven't fallen apart. I can still bite.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我打得更松了。
lines.en: That hit only loosened me further.

lines.zh: 腐肉递近点，我牙口还成。
lines.en: Bring that rotten flesh closer. My teeth still work.

lines.zh: 秋天的腐肉，也带点落叶味。
lines.en: Autumn rotten flesh tastes faintly of fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 这块肉，烂得正合我口味。
lines.en: This flesh is rotted just how I like it.

lines.zh: 拿着腐肉，我会跟到天黑。
lines.en: Hold out rotten flesh and I'll follow you till dusk.

lines.zh: 肚子空了几十年，还认得饿。
lines.en: Empty for decades, and I still know hunger.

lines.zh: 枯叶味混着肉香，真不错。
lines.en: Dead-leaf smell mixed with meat. Not bad at all.

lines.zh: 你身上的血味，让我挪不开步。
lines.en: The smell of your blood pins my feet in place.

lines.zh: 秋叶落在肩上，我不拍掉。
lines.en: Autumn leaves on my shoulder. I leave them.

lines.zh: 铁锭在我兜里，碰着你的肉。
lines.en: The iron ingot in my pocket knocks against your flesh.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，我只吃肉。
lines.en: Keep that hand back. It's the meat I want.

lines.zh: 我让开。慢慢让。
lines.en: I'll move. Slowly.

lines.zh: 我身上的铁锭，还带着锈。
lines.en: The iron on me still tastes of rust.

lines.zh: 你撞掉了我肩上的落叶。
lines.en: You knocked the leaves off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，肋骨响了一声。
lines.en: You bumped me, and a rib clicked.

lines.zh: 别急，我的关节经不起撞。
lines.en: Slow down. These joints can't take a knock.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞响了我的肋骨。
lines.en: Your shoulder rattled my ribs.

lines.zh: 森林里怎么这么烫？
lines.en: Why is the forest so hot?

lines.zh: 我的骨头硌到你了。
lines.en: My bones poked you.

lines.zh: 走开，落叶都粘我身上。
lines.en: Back off — leaves are stuck all over me.

lines.zh: 踩在落叶上，我的脚一直在滑。
lines.en: On fallen leaves my feet keep slipping.

lines.zh: 秋天的叶子盖着我，也不暖。
lines.en: Autumn leaves cover me and give no warmth.

lines.zh: 枯叶里有虫子，你听。
lines.en: There are bugs in the dead leaves. Listen.

lines.zh: 我皮下的肉早就凉透了。
lines.en: The flesh beneath my skin went cold long ago.

lines.zh: 枯叶季节里，我居然想靠着你。
lines.en: In leaf-fall season I actually want to lean on you.

lines.zh: 秋天的果子，我咬不动。
lines.en: Autumn fruit — my teeth can't work it.

lines.zh: 秋月下，我的骨头也在等你。
lines.en: Under the autumn moon even my bones wait for you.

lines.zh: 我抬手想碰你，指甲太长了。
lines.en: I reach for you, but my nails grew too long.

lines.zh: 两个人在落叶堆里，站到天亮。
lines.en: The two of us in the leaf pile, standing till dawn.

lines.zh: 我这身秋色，是烂了才有的。
lines.en: This autumn color came from rot.

lines.zh: 你也变成落叶色，就能陪我。
lines.en: Turn leaf-brown too, and you can stay with me.

lines.zh: 这铁锭，配我兜里那一块。
lines.en: This iron ingot will match the one in my pocket.

lines.zh: 森林的落叶，盖了我一身。
lines.en: Forest leaves covered me whole.

lines.zh: 塞进肋骨里，就丢不了。
lines.en: Tuck it between my ribs and it can't be lost.

lines.zh: 秋色落叶里捡的，归我。
lines.en: Picked from the autumn leaves — mine.

lines.zh: 花瓣……不是我的。
lines.en: A petals... not mine.

lines.zh: 生前的旧物，灰里捡回来的。
lines.en: Something from my living days, lifted from the ash.

lines.zh: 僵死的手指，居然夹住了。
lines.en: My dead fingers actually held on.

lines.zh: 铁锈和落叶，我都捡。
lines.en: Rust and fallen leaves — I pick up both.

lines.zh: 落叶盖住的东西，我都翻出来。
lines.en: I turn up whatever the leaves bury.

lines.zh: 指节僵着，它差点滑下去。
lines.en: My knuckles are stiff; it nearly slipped out.

lines.zh: 落叶一响，我就盯上你了。
lines.en: One rustle of leaves and my eyes are on you.

lines.zh: 那颗心在跳，我听得一清二楚。
lines.en: That heart is beating. I hear it perfectly.

lines.zh: 林子这么深，只剩你一个人。
lines.en: The woods run this deep and you're the only one left.

lines.zh: 秋天的颜色，替我藏身。
lines.en: Autumn colors hide me.

lines.zh: 隔着落叶，我锁住你的热气。
lines.en: Through the leaf litter I lock onto your warmth.

lines.zh: 秋色里，你跑不出我的眼。
lines.en: In this autumn light you can't slip my sight.

lines.zh: 活人，停下，我的骨头发痒。
lines.en: Living one, halt. My bones itch.

lines.zh: 你先跑，我脚慢但不会停。
lines.en: Run ahead. My feet are slow, never stopping.

lines.zh: 森林的落叶色，就是我的皮。
lines.en: The colour of fallen leaves is my skin.

lines.zh: 找了半个秋天，就是这张脸。
lines.en: Half an autumn of searching, and here's that face.

lines.zh: 我埋在落叶下，等了你很久。
lines.en: Buried under the leaves, I waited long for you.

lines.zh: 你身上没有腐味，真稀奇。
lines.en: No rot on you at all. Curious.

lines.zh: 我的腿僵，可从不觉得累。
lines.en: My legs are stiff, but they never tire.

lines.zh: 森林里落叶一响，我就转头。
lines.en: A leaf rustles and I turn.

lines.zh: 橙色的皮，烂得更快。
lines.en: Orange skin rots faster.

lines.zh: 落叶太厚，我一步一步追。
lines.en: The leaves are deep; I follow step by step.

lines.zh: 前面是秋天的死路，落叶太厚。
lines.en: Ahead is an autumn dead end, leaves too deep.

lines.zh: 森林里，你已经没有退路。
lines.en: In this forest, you have no way back.

lines.zh: 就算跛着，我也跟到林子尽头。
lines.en: Even limping, I'll follow to the forest's edge.

lines.zh: 腐肉和铁锭，都在这身里。
lines.en: Rotten flesh and iron, all in this body.

lines.zh: 你的鞋踩碎枯叶，我全听得见。
lines.en: Your boots crack dead leaves. I hear all of it.

lines.zh: 慢点，我的骨头跟不上。
lines.en: Slow down. These bones can't keep up.

lines.zh: 你喘得越急，我越是饿。
lines.en: The harder you pant, the hungrier I get.

lines.zh: 小心树根，我就在你后头。
lines.en: Mind the roots. I'm right behind you.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的落叶印走了很久。
lines.en: I followed your leaf prints a long way.

lines.zh: 我这身皮，和落叶一个色。
lines.en: My skin matches the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 这片林子绕不出去的，活人。
lines.en: There's no way out of these woods, living one.

lines.zh: 腐肉里装着铁锭，很沉。
lines.en: Iron ingots in rotten flesh. Heavy.

lines.zh: 我不用喘气，你倒是快了。
lines.en: I need no breath; you are the one panting.

lines.zh: 回头，看看这身秋色的皮。
lines.en: Turn around. Look at this autumn hide.

lines.zh: 落叶下面，你的脚印很清楚。
lines.en: Under the leaves your prints are clear.

lines.zh: 秋天的僵尸，等你喘完。
lines.en: An autumn zombie waits for you to finish panting.

lines.zh: 落叶堆里，我慢慢站起来。
lines.en: I rise slowly from the leaf pile.

lines.zh: 我的关节里塞着落叶。
lines.en: Dead leaves are packed in my joints.

lines.zh: 秋天的森林，落叶盖着我。
lines.en: In the autumn forest, fallen leaves cover me.

lines.zh: 我这一爪，带着腐肉味。
lines.en: This claw of mine smells of rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 秋天的皮一碰就掉，别嫌脏。
lines.en: This autumn skin flakes at a touch. Don't mind the mess.

lines.zh: 我的指节擦过你的肩，凉吧。
lines.en: My knuckles brushed your shoulder. Cold, isn't it?

lines.zh: 这一拳打偏，我补一下。
lines.en: That swing went wide. Let me correct it.

lines.zh: 这一下，我在落叶下攒了很久。
lines.en: This blow, I saved up under the leaves.

lines.zh: 只擦到你的袖子，可惜。
lines.en: Only grazed your sleeve. A pity.

lines.zh: 森林里的铁锭，我揣着。
lines.en: I've got an iron ingot from the forest.

lines.zh: 手臂僵着，抬起来费劲。
lines.en: My arm is stiff; raising it is hard.

lines.zh: 铁锭在我手里，还是凉的。
lines.en: The iron ingot in my hand is still cold.

lines.zh: 叫也没用，林子里没人。
lines.en: Screaming won't help. No one is in these woods.

lines.zh: 你退到树根那儿了，正好。
lines.en: You've backed up to the roots. Perfect.

lines.zh: 落叶下，我伸出手。
lines.en: Under the leaves, I reach out.

lines.zh: 秋林里的我，比树还冷。
lines.en: In the autumn wood, I am colder than the trees.

lines.zh: 我的手停不下来，抱歉。
lines.en: My hand won't stop itself. Sorry.

lines.zh: 秋色的天，把我从土里叫醒。
lines.en: An autumn sky called me up out of the soil.

lines.zh: 落叶盖了我一整个秋天。
lines.en: Leaves buried me all autumn.

lines.zh: 落叶堆里躺了一季，骨头都硬了。
lines.en: A season under the leaves left me stiff.

lines.zh: 秋色的皮，天一黑就醒。
lines.en: Autumn-colored skin wakes with the dark.

lines.zh: 我扒开叶子，把自己撑起来。
lines.en: I push the leaves aside and prop myself up.

lines.zh: 刚爬出来，身上的土还没掉。
lines.en: Just crawled out. The dirt's still on me.

lines.zh: 秋色的尸体，不知该往哪去。
lines.en: An autumn-colored corpse, unsure where to go.

lines.zh: 谁把我从落叶里叫醒的。
lines.en: Who woke me from the leaf litter?

lines.zh: 天黑了，林子里归我走动。
lines.en: Dark now. These woods are mine to walk.

lines.zh: 别点灯，省点光。
lines.en: Don't light a torch — save the light.

lines.zh: 这地方变了。
lines.en: This place has changed.

lines.zh: 又是这身烂皮，秋天归我。
lines.en: This rotting hide again. Autumn belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我从落叶里爬了出来。
lines.en: I clawed my way out of the leaves.

lines.zh: 从土里出来就这样，一直凉。
lines.en: Cold since I left the soil. Always cold.

lines.zh: 焦味……是我的。
lines.en: That burning smell... mine.

lines.zh: 肩胛骨掉了，我先捡回来。
lines.en: My shoulder blade dropped off. I'll pick it back up.

lines.zh: 林中的水塘，泡软了我。
lines.en: The forest pond has softened me.

lines.zh: 落叶一样的皮，被炸开。
lines.en: Leaf-brown skin, blown open.

lines.zh: 我身上还挂着铁锭呢。
lines.en: I'm still carrying an iron ingot.

lines.zh: 光烧进骨头里了。
lines.en: Light burns into my bones.

lines.zh: 肋骨间空空的，能穿过风。
lines.en: Wind blows straight between my ribs.

lines.zh: 雷认得我。
lines.en: Lightning knows me.

lines.zh: 落叶和土都够不着，一直坠。
lines.en: Neither leaves nor soil. Just falling.
